mentions.name: OrcaBot agent skills benchmarks
mentions.description: This project benchmarks public agent skill packs (Oh My ClaudeCode, Superpowers, Git Ship Done, previously Get Shit Done, and Karpathy's skills) against SWE-Bench-Pro and SlopCodeBench, publishing a July vs June comparison that reveals the cost and performance impact of using these skills.
mentions.source_excerpt: Benchmarking public agent skills: Oh My ClaudeCode, Superpowers, Git Ship Done, (previously Get Shit Done), and the Karpathy ones against Swebench-Pro and SlopCodeBench. I have a July vs June breakdown. It's been an interesting learning exercise and reveals the cost/performance impact of using these.
